I don't EVER want to hear the Republican Party or any of their cult members say shit about #BackTheBlue and #BlueLivesMatter ever again.

Because this has made it very apparent that it was always about finding an underhanded way to say black lives don't matter.

No, it is not a coincidence that the far left who referred to black voters in South Carolina as "low info voters" just happen to hate Kamala Harris with a strange passion.

Because no, having #BlackLivesMatter in their bio does not prove them to be antiracist.

Yea, fuck Rep. Dan Newhouse. Good on you supporting impeachment, but fuck you for having the audacity to compare #BlackLivesMatter to the white supremacists storming the US Capitol and attempting to install a dictator.

You don't get a pass for doing the bare minimum.
